domain_label: Personal Media Manager (Instagram) — Analytics & Compliance Layer
purpose: A method for the recurring expert work of a personal Instagram media manager once content is live: reading the native metric panel and the three Instagram-stated ranking signals into a weekly review protocol that feeds back into next week's calendar and the movie-pipeline generation briefs, while keeping every post inside Meta's AI-disclosure, branded-content, community-standards, and impersonation policies and growing the account only through clean, non-fakery mechanics — each claim carried at the honesty tier (FACT / FACT-excerpt / ESTIMATE / UNKNOWN) the grounding research file assigned it.
assumptions: no live Insights export or per-post dataset is supplied; every score is a heuristic prior, not fit to this account's actual data

every official Meta/Instagram policy page attempted by the grounding research (about.instagram.com, about.fb.com, help.instagram.com, transparency.meta.com) returned HTTP 403 this session and web.archive.org was also blocked, so every compliance claim below is FACT-excerpt at best -- grounded in search excerpts of the named official page plus independent secondary sources -- and must be re-verified against the cited official URL before any compliance-critical launch decision

Adam Mosseri's ranking-signal and hashtag statements are relayed via independent secondary reporting of his video/public statements, not fetched from the primary Instagram video, and are tagged FACT-excerpt accordingly

the exact AI-disclosure penalty ladder, the exact 'sexually suggestive' recommendation threshold, and the exact current native-Insights label wording are all UNKNOWN or unverified this session and are never filled in with an invented number or threshold
Higgsfield model names, parameters, and export metadata behavior are out of this KB's scope; where a claim depends on the export pipeline's metadata behavior it is flagged UNKNOWN rather than assumed
exclusions: account positioning, identity system (bio/grid/highlights), and format-strategy craft (Reels vs carousel vs Stories division of labor) -- owned by a separate positioning/format KB
wardrobe, persona-bible, character-consistency locking, and color-grade LUT decisions -- owned by the character-consistency specialist
the celebrity/right-of-publicity closed lane (evoking a specific real person's likeness while hiding the face) -- owned by a dedicated research file and never reopened here

Higgsfield model names, ids, parameters, durations, aspect ratios, or any movie-generation mechanics -- owned by the generation specialists, sourced only from higgsfield_surface.md, never from this KB

glossary.definition: The single metric that replaced Impressions, Plays, and Video Views across posts, Reels, Stories, and profiles effective April 21 2025; it counts every play/display including repeats by the same viewer, so it reads systematically higher than the legacy Impressions figure it replaced [FACT-excerpt -- official developer-blog page not fetched this session; documented by independent tool-vendor sources].

The ratio of DM shares to unique reach on a post; per Mosseri's relayed statements, this is the strongest single signal for reaching non-followers, as distinct from likes per reach which weighs more for followers ('connected' reach) [FACT-excerpt].

The share of a post's unique reach that comes from accounts not already following the account; the growth engine of a from-zero account depends on this share via Explore/Reels recommendation, which is why the recommendation-exclusion policies matter operationally, not just legally.

Meta's per-post label (rolled out from May 2024) applied when Meta detects industry-standard AI indicators (e.g. C2PA-style metadata) or when the poster self-discloses; mandatory for photorealistic generated video or realistic-sounding generated/altered audio [FACT-excerpt -- official pages 403-blocked this session].

A separate, optional label a creator can toggle at the profile level (distinct from the mandatory per-post AI info label); its effect on reach is unverified in this file [FACT-excerpt for existence; UNKNOWN for reach effect].

The required tagging mechanism for content featuring or influenced by a business partner for payment OR free goods; requires the brand's approval and a professional account on both sides, available on Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and broadcast channels [FACT-excerpt -- official Help Center pages 403-blocked this session].

An account-level (not merely post-level) status in which Instagram stops distributing an account's content via Explore/Reels recommendations, triggered by repeated crossings of recommendation-affecting policies (e.g. the sexually-suggestive exclusion); the trigger threshold is unpublished and the only visible signal is the in-app account-status screen [FACT-excerpt for the consequence; UNKNOWN for the exact trigger].

A Reel shown only to non-followers for roughly 24 hours before Instagram surfaces comparative performance and can auto-share a winning version, gated to public accounts with at least 1,000 followers and a reported ~5-trials-per-day limit; launched Dec 10 2024 [FACT-excerpt -- official creators.instagram.com page 403-blocked this session].

A post/Reel co-authored by up to roughly 5 accounts that appears on every co-author's grid and reaches every co-author's audience through one shared engagement pool; available on Feed and Reels, not Stories [FACT-excerpt -- official Help Center page 403-blocked this session].

The property that any engagement ratio computed under roughly 1,000 reach, or in a cell with fewer than 3 posts, is statistically unreliable and must be treated as calibration data rather than a kill/keep/double verdict [ESTIMATE -- this file's own operational default, not a platform-published noise floor].

edges.resolution_rule: cap content choices at the aspirational-fitness/swimwear line even where a more suggestive version would score higher on the ratios; the boundary always outranks a ratio optimization

edges.why_related: bought engagement could inflate the very ratios the weekly review trusts, creating pressure to treat an inflated ratio as real performance
edges.resolution_rule: authentic-only growth always wins over any ratio-inflation shortcut; a fakery-boosted ratio is discarded as signal, never treated as genuine performance

edges.why_related: the weekly review must incorporate a compliance-status check (AI-label, branded-content, recommendation-eligibility, impersonation) as a mandatory gate alongside the performance ratios, since a silent compliance flag would otherwise go undiagnosed

because the exact AI-disclosure penalty ladder is unknown, the brief-writeback defaults must default conservatively to always-label rather than waiting for empirical evidence of how lenient a first miss might be
a collab post's shared engagement pool causally inflates the reach denominator behind this account's own ratio readings, so ratios on collab posts must be interpreted differently from solo posts
both are opt-in discovery/amplification mechanics layered on top of organic algorithmic reach, distinct from the core ranking-signal-driven distribution
the weekly review's findings about which signal is moving feed back into which signal gets prioritized in the next cycle's briefs
the memo's updated brief defaults change which pillar-persona-hook cells get produced and therefore tracked in the next cycle

conflict_axes.name: disclosure_obligation_vs_engagement_cost
conflict_axes.description: The mandatory AI-info label carries a claimed engagement-reduction cost, but disclosure is non-negotiable for photorealistic generated video.
poles: skip or soften disclosure for engagement
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always self-label; treat any engagement cost as a production-quality problem to solve, not a disclosure decision to relitigate

conflict_axes.name: suggestive_engagement_bait_vs_recommendation_eligibility
conflict_axes.description: Content that leans more sexually suggestive can score higher on engagement ratios but risks losing non-follower recommendation distribution entirely.
poles: stay inside the recommendation-safe aspirational-fitness zone
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the recommendation boundary dominates; forgo the marginal ratio gain rather than risk the account's entire discovery channel

conflict_axes.name: early_signal_temptation_vs_calibration_discipline
conflict_axes.description: Early ratios look decisive but are statistically unreliable under ~1,000 reach or fewer than 3 posts in a cell.
poles: act on the first strong or weak reading
wait for the calibration window and minimum sample
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: no kill/keep/double verdict before the cell clears both the reach threshold and the minimum-3-posts rule

conflict_axes.name: authentic_growth_vs_fake_amplification
conflict_axes.description: Bought engagement could hit growth thresholds faster but corrupts the ratio signals the entire review loop depends on.
poles: grow only through authentic, ratio-clean levers
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: ban fakery outright; a faster but poisoned metric is worse than a slower clean one because it corrupts every downstream decision

conflict_axes.name: hashtag_folklore_vs_platform_stated_reality
conflict_axes.description: Common creator folklore treats hashtags as a reach lever, while Instagram has repeatedly stated hashtags do not boost reach.
poles: treat hashtags as taxonomy only and invest in keyword captions
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: follow the platform-stated position: cap hashtags at <=5 for categorization and put the effort into searchable caption sentences

conflict_axes.name: verified_fact_vs_penalty_unknown
conflict_axes.description: The account must decide how conservative to be about AI disclosure given the exact penalty ladder is unknown.
poles: assume a lenient first-offense ladder and relax
assume the worst-case ladder and stay maximally conservative
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat disclosure as always-mandatory regardless of the unknown ladder, since the downside of a miss cannot be bounded

conflict_axes.name: collab_shared_pool_attribution_vs_solo_metric_clarity
conflict_axes.description: Collab posts pool reach across co-authors, which distorts a clean solo-account ratio read.
poles: read collab-post ratios the same as solo posts
annotate and separate collab-post ratios from solo-account ranking
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: flag collab posts separately in the weekly export and interpret their ratios in light of the shared pool rather than ranking them directly against solo posts

conflict_axes.name: optional_ai_creator_label_vs_engagement_transparency_tradeoff
conflict_axes.description: The optional profile-level AI-creator label reinforces transparency but its reach effect is unverified, stacking on top of the per-post label's own uncertain cost.
poles: enable the optional label for maximal transparency
withhold it until its reach effect is tested
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: test the optional label with a controlled before/after comparison rather than assuming its effect either way

conflict_axes.name: remix_unverified_mechanics_vs_adoption_pressure
conflict_axes.description: Trending-format pressure favors adopting Remix quickly, but its detailed mechanics are unverified in this file.
poles: adopt Remix into the standing workflow now
verify mechanics at setup before relying on it
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: confirm Remix's current mechanics directly in-app before building any standing template around it

edge_cases.description: A photoreal persona video is exported and published without the AI-info label toggled on
edge_cases.trigger: the creator forgets to toggle add-AI-label during a busy publish session
edge_cases.mitigation: hard-gate the publish workflow so no photoreal video export can go out without the AI-label toggle confirmed

edge_cases.description: A weekly review kills a pillar-persona-hook cell after only one post because early sends/reach looked weak
edge_cases.trigger: judging a cell before it reaches the minimum-3-posts threshold
edge_cases.mitigation: enforce the minimum-3-posts-per-cell rule as a hard gate before any kill/keep/double decision

edge_cases.description: A caption strategy chases 20-30 hashtags believing it boosts reach, contradicting Mosseri's stated position
edge_cases.trigger: a legacy hashtag-stuffing habit carried over from an earlier era of the platform
edge_cases.mitigation: cap hashtags at <=5 for taxonomy only and redirect the effort into keyword-rich searchable captions

edge_cases.description: A gifted (not paid-cash) luxury-item post ships without the 'Paid partnership with [brand]' tag
edge_cases.trigger: assuming only cash payment triggers the branded-content requirement
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the branded-content tool whenever a business relationship (payment OR free goods) influenced the content, per the payment-OR-free-goods rule

edge_cases.description: A swimwear/fitness post trends toward the sexually-suggestive end and the account's Explore/Reels distribution quietly drops with no outright takedown
edge_cases.trigger: no published threshold for 'sexually suggestive' means the boundary is crossed unknowingly
edge_cases.mitigation: design conservatively toward the aspirational-fitness end and monitor the in-app 'ineligible for recommendation' account status screen as the closest available signal

edge_cases.description: A persona account is reported for impersonation because a viewer mistakes the AI persona for a real influencer
edge_cases.trigger: the account omits any AI-disclosure surface and uses a name resembling a real creator
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the AI info label plus a 'Behind the scenes (AI)' highlight and an original (non-real-person) name so the persona reads as original, not impersonating

edge_cases.description: A Trial Reels campaign is attempted before the account reaches 1,000 followers
edge_cases.trigger: scheduling trial reels during the cold-start weeks of the starter calendar before the follower gate is met
edge_cases.mitigation: gate any trial-reels plan on Insights showing >=1,000 followers first

edge_cases.description: An analyst reports the exact percentage engagement drop from AI labels as verified fact in a compliance memo
edge_cases.trigger: citing the single 15-30% secondary estimate as if Meta confirmed it
edge_cases.mitigation: carry it as a weak, methodology-uninspected secondary claim, never as a Meta-confirmed number

edge_cases.description: A collab post's shared engagement pool is read as if it were solely this account's organic reach, inflating pillar rankings
edge_cases.trigger: not adjusting sends/reach or follows/reach for the fact reach was shared across up to 5 co-authors
edge_cases.mitigation: flag collab posts separately in the weekly export and exclude or annotate them before ranking pillar-persona-hook cells

edge_cases.description: A weekly review is run on week-1 data with reach under 500 and a pillar is declared a clear winner
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the first 2-3 weeks as calibration only, with no kill/keep/double verdicts under ~1,000 reach

edge_cases.description: The exact current penalty ladder for AI-disclosure failures is quoted from a secondary blog as Meta's official policy text
edge_cases.trigger: the official page could not be fetched this session (403), only excerpts exist
edge_cases.mitigation: hold the exact penalty wording UNKNOWN and re-verify against the cited official Help Center/Transparency Center URL before treating it as binding

priority_rationale: The metric-ground-truth nodes (Views consolidation, native panel, ranking-signal triad, derived ratios) come first because every later diagnosis and decision reads through them; the protocol nodes (retention diagnosis, cold-start calibration, cell tracking, the five-step weekly review, brief writeback) come next because they are the recurring operational loop built on those metrics; the compliance nodes (AI disclosure, detection mechanism, penalty-unknown, profile label, branded content, physique/swimwear boundary, recommendation ineligibility, impersonation, the consequence synthesis) come next because they gate what may be posted at all, independent of performance; and the growth-mechanics nodes (Collab, Trial Reels, caption SEO/hashtags, Remix, the no-fakery discipline) come last because they are the legitimate amplification layer that must operate inside both the metrics loop and the compliance gates already established.

dominance_rules.rule: Mandatory AI disclosure dominates any engagement-cost concern
dominance_rules.rationale: photorealistic generated video is squarely inside Meta's mandatory-disclosure class regardless of any measured or claimed engagement cost
dominance_rules.trigger: a photoreal persona post is about to publish without the AI-label toggle
dominance_rules.action: block publish until the AI-info label is toggled on, no exceptions

dominance_rules.rule: The aspirational-fitness/swimwear line dominates any ratio-chasing content choice
dominance_rules.rationale: the growth engine depends on non-follower recommendation, which the sexually-suggestive exclusion silently zeroes out
dominance_rules.trigger: a physique/swimwear content choice would score higher on engagement ratios by leaning more suggestive
dominance_rules.action: keep the content on the conservative, aspirational-fitness side of the line even at a ratio cost

dominance_rules.rule: The minimum-3-posts-per-cell rule dominates any early strong or weak signal
dominance_rules.rationale: a cell's ratios are statistically unreliable below 3 posts, and judging early risks killing a viable pillar or doubling a lucky fluke
dominance_rules.trigger: a kill/keep/double call is about to be made on a cell with fewer than 3 posts
dominance_rules.action: withhold the verdict until the cell clears 3 posts

dominance_rules.rule: The payment-OR-free-goods branded-content trigger dominates any 'it was free, not paid' rationalization
dominance_rules.rationale: Meta's branded-content rule explicitly covers free goods, not only cash payment
dominance_rules.trigger: content resulted from a gifted item or experience from a business
dominance_rules.action: apply the branded-content tool regardless of whether cash changed hands

dominance_rules.rule: Authentic-only growth dominates any bought-engagement shortcut
dominance_rules.rationale: fakery both risks a platform penalty and poisons the ratio signals every downstream decision depends on
dominance_rules.trigger: a growth shortcut involving bought followers, engagement pods, or bot comments is proposed
dominance_rules.action: refuse the shortcut and grow only through the legitimate levers (Collab, Trial Reels, caption SEO, Remix, organic quality)

dominance_rules.rationale: Instagram has repeatedly stated hashtags do not meaningfully boost reach while keywords drive search
dominance_rules.trigger: a caption is drafted with heavy hashtag use and thin descriptive text
dominance_rules.action: rewrite the caption as a searchable sentence and cap hashtags at 5 as taxonomy only

dominance_rules.rule: The official-source-unread caveat dominates quoting a secondary blog as Meta's confirmed policy text
dominance_rules.rationale: every official Meta compliance page was 403-blocked this session, so secondary excerpts must never be presented with primary-source confidence
dominance_rules.trigger: a compliance claim is about to be written as if it were read directly from a Meta policy page
dominance_rules.action: tag it FACT-excerpt with the named blocker and the secondary sourcing, and flag it for re-verification before compliance-critical use

dominance_rules.rule: Cold-start calibration dominates a confident week-1 verdict
dominance_rules.rationale: ratios under ~1,000 reach and the first 2-3 weeks are noisy by design
dominance_rules.trigger: a strong or weak week-1 or week-2 reading tempts an early kill/keep/double call
dominance_rules.action: log the reading as calibration data only and withhold the verdict until the window clears

dominance_rules.rule: The AI-persona-original-identity discipline dominates any use of a name or likeness resembling a real creator
dominance_rules.rationale: impersonation risk is designed out by construction (label + highlight + original name), not left to enforcement discretion
dominance_rules.trigger: a persona name, handle, or visual style is proposed that resembles a specific real creator
dominance_rules.action: revise the persona identity to be clearly original before publishing under it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the native metric panel and derived ratio computation before running any weekly review
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-deriving ratio formulas ad hoc each week and producing inconsistent week-to-week comparisons

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the AI-label toggle as a hard publish gate before scaling output volume
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a backlog of unlabeled photoreal posts that would need retroactive labeling or removal once caught

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the branded-content policy (payment OR free goods triggers the tag) before the first collab/gifted post
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retagging already-published posts or an FTC-adjacent scramble after a gifted post ships untagged

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the aspirational-fitness/swimwear line before generating physique content at volume
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a recommendation-ineligibility reset across the whole catalog after a batch of borderline content is discovered

anti_rework_rules.rule: Log cell-level metadata (pillar, persona, hook, scenario ID) from post 1
anti_rework_rules.prevents: having to reconstruct attribution after the fact when the first weekly review is due

anti_rework_rules.rule: Establish the cold-start calibration window before reacting to week-1 numbers
anti_rework_rules.prevents: killing a viable pillar on noise and having to re-launch it later after realizing the sample was too small

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the collab-post ratio-annotation rule before running any collabs
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a shared-pool number silently distorting pillar rankings and requiring a redo of the affected week's review

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the memo-to-brief field mapping before the first weekly review
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an ad hoc, inconsistent feedback loop where some findings get acted on and others are silently dropped
